limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter wrap but dropped the original `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted input of a group replaces `data_out` even when the downstream is not ready, whereas the reference adds it to the existing value.
The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so its backpressure cases validated the rewrite rather than checking that it preserved the original accumulation behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire simulation invocation, so the agent had to resubmit the testbench using a different temporary-directory mechanism.
